description: Golden set v0 — 20 hand-authored cases for the search input pipeline (E18). Each case exercises a specific resolver / pipeline behaviour and acts as a regression baseline.

cases.description: English name resolves via exact_name — case sensitive input
Quantity prefix is stripped before resolving
Input is case-insensitive — ALL CAPS still resolves
Multi-word Swahili alias resolves (Unga wa mahindi → maize flour)
Staples are auto-added to the pool when an ingredient resolves
Explicitly excluded staple is NOT added to the pool
Empty input list returns empty ResolvedQuery
Mixed input — one matched, one unmatched
Duplicate inputs are deduplicated — tomato appears once in matched_ids
Multi-token query — Tomato + Onion both resolve
Pool completeness — typing only maize flour covers ugali non-staple requirements
is_empty is True when only unmatched tokens given
